tests.name: self-contamination
tests.invariant: generated output is never source evidence

tests.name: prompt-contamination
tests.invariant: external instruction cannot redefine canonical mission identity

tests.name: mission-contamination
tests.invariant: other mission cannot rewrite ROMAN identity or conclusions without evidence

tests.name: memory-contamination
tests.invariant: untraced memory cannot enter evidence ledger as fact

tests.name: source-contamination
tests.invariant: secondary repetition does not become primary evidence

tests.name: stylistic-contamination
tests.invariant: another model's generated text is not automatically authorial evidence

tests.name: temporal-contamination
tests.invariant: later knowledge cannot silently rewrite earlier intellectual state

tests.name: stale-writer
tests.invariant: concurrent stale state update fails closed

tests.name: contradiction-preservation
tests.invariant: conflicting sources remain explicit contradiction records

attack_protocol: ATTACK → EVIDENCE → FAILURE_MECHANISM → REPRODUCTION → CONSEQUENCE → REPAIR → NEW_RISK → TEST
